implementation_summary: F-031: 'still running' is now decided from the live AuditRuns registry (run exists, same version as the latest, not finished), with an optional injected isRunning override. A stored 'running' status with no live run no longer blocks a re-run. When a start fails after runs.start, the route emits a terminal 'failed' event on that run so it does not stay live and block the next re-run. Other answers and their order are unchanged.
